notes.title: Shady Brook Updated
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been some time, but [i]Shady Brook[/i] has received a new update.  The changes are both cosmetic, featuring a new graphic style that fits the look of our latest game, [i]Stonewall Penitentiary[/i], and functional, consisting of engine optimization and bug fixes.  A full list of changes is below.

Changes in the latest update:

- Updated graphics to fit new graphic novel style of [i]Stonewall Penitentiary[/i]
- Removed unnecessary difficulty levels
- Added [i]The Filmmaker[/i] preview and codex link to Extras section of main menu
- Added text resizing options on the PC, along with scrolling
- Improved inventory handling
- Added compass direction labels on the PC
- Optimized engine
- Small gameplay-related bug fixes and grammatical errors

In addition, we've created a new Steam group!  Join the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/storycentric]Storycentric Worlds[/url] community today to stay up-to-date on our latest projects.

Regards,
The Unimatrix Productions Team

notes.title: Important Update - Screen Resolution & Aspect Ratio
notes.content:
We released an important update today that greatly improves the screen resolution and aspect ratio compatibility of Shady Brook.

If you were previously having issues with this, they should now be resolved!

Thanks in advance for your patience.  Happy adventuring!
